name: Alpaca MCP
description: Trades stocks, ETFs, crypto, and options through a regulated broker from an agent, covering positions, orders, and market data with a paper-trading sandbox.

skills.name: Order Placement
skills.description: Places, modifies, and cancels equity, crypto, and options orders against a live or paper brokerage account.

skills.name: Position Tracking
skills.description: Reports open positions, account balances, and realised profit and loss for portfolio-aware agent decisions.

skills.name: Market Data
skills.description: Fetches quotes, bars, and historical price data for supported instruments to inform trading logic.
